description: This file contains PHP functions related to handling document tree data, including generating node data, category nodes, and document nodes for a document management tree structure within a CRM system (SuiteCRM/SugarCRM). It manages database queries, node creation, and JSON encoding for tree rendering.

methods.name: get_node_data
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded array of nodes for a document tree structure based on input parameters such as depth and node IDs.

methods.name: get_category_nodes
methods.description: Generates and returns nodes representing document categories and subcategories, constructing Node objects from database query results.

methods.name: get_documents
methods.description: Retrieves document nodes from the database filtered by category and subcategory, returning a list of Node objects.
